Conjugate invariance m(la)=m(la^t) holds for all la (consistent with chi_{la^t}=sgn*chi_la, so chi^2 is invariant). originality.rationale: Substantive comparison against nearest priors shows a genuine gap, not a timestamp argument. (1) Bessenrodt-Bowman arXiv:1609.03596 classifies multiplicity-free Kronecker products with decomposition formulas: a sparsity classification, silent on whether square-vectors separate irreps up to sign. (2) Pak-Panova-Vallejo arXiv:1304.0738 proves Saxl-positivity for hooks/two-rows via a character criterion: sufficient containment conditions, not fingerprint injectivity or minimal separators. (3) Zhao arXiv:2309.00764 gives formulas/positivity for square-shape squares on three-row/near-hook families: family positivity, not all-irrep separation at n=6-8. (4) Lecouvey math/0703514 gives symmetric/antisymmetric splitting via Littlewood-Richardson coefficients for classical Lie groups: different groups and question. (5) GAP CTblLib ships character tables but publishes no square-fingerprint separation theorem or separator certificates; candidate recomputes tables from MN rather than reprinting. (6) arXiv full-text search for square-separates/square-determines queries returns no results (verified live). Square equality determines chi^2 as a class function but factor recovery up to sign still requires the exhaustive pairwise check performed here, so the result is not mechanically implied. No prior states or implies m(la)=m(mu) iff mu in {la,la^t} at n=6-8 with lex-first separators.

value.rationale: Headline is a rigorously established exact invariant of specific natural objects: the Kronecker-square vectors m(la)=(g(la,la,nu))_nu for every irreducible of S_6,S_7,S_8. Motivation predates computation: whether a tensor square determines its factor up to sign sits beside the Saxl tensor-square conjecture and GCT character-recognition / square-root-uniqueness benchmarks. Scope n=6-8 (p=11/15/22, 6/8/12 conjugation classes) is the first consecutive slice with structurally nontrivial squares while staying exhaustive and hand-replayable, not an arbitrary slice. Values were not known or mechanically implied before the pairwise comparison (a collision was a live possibility with a stated fallback). A future researcher can reasonably need the precise facts: the 6/8/12-way classification, the zero-collision boundary, and the 109 lex-first separating coordinates with class-sum certificates as checkable fingerprints/benchmarks. This is one exact classification datum per n, but under the applicable standard such a narrow exact invariant is independently worth retrieving. It is not a textbook restatement (no textbook states this separation), not a parameter substitution, not a tiny unmotivated gain, and not an unexplained enumeration (every number carries a separator certificate and interpretation). Certification strengthens but does not substitute for the substantive boundary.
